Card Q&A.a: No. Whether or not you play a Digimon with this card’s effect is irrelevant. You still place it in your battle area.
Card Q&A.q: I use this card’s effect, but there are either no black Digimon cards with play costs of 4 or less among the revealed cards, or there is one, but I choose not to play it. Do I discard this card instead of placing it in my battle area?

Effect: [Main] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. You may play 1 black Digimon card with a play cost of 4 or less among them without paying its memory cost. Trash the remaining cards. Then, place this card in your battle area.
[Main] ＜Delay＞ (Trash this card in your battle area to activate the effect below. You can't activate this effect the turn this card enters play.)
Security Effect: [Security] Place this card in its owner's battle area.
